resources.string: Joy-Cons send input about twice as often, for smoother motion and quicker buttons.
Uses more battery on the Joy-Cons and this device.
Ignore this device\'s motion in Eden
Eden adds this device\'s gyro to Player 1, which makes controller motion stutter. Lifted when the Virtual Gamepad and DSU are both off.

Makes small stick movements easier to control, for every controller in the Virtual Gamepad and DSU. Precision softens the middle of the stick and still reaches full at the edge; Max tilt caps full deflection.
